name: jev-official-usage
title: browser-with-typesafe: adopt Jev's official 3-layer usage
description: Introduce the text-entry helper (a fast free LLM generates field values while Jev only selects actions), refactor decide() into a multi-question request (operation + click_target + fill_target in one call), add a search+filter+form state-dependent fixture, measure both arms under the original criterion (B ≤ 0.8×A on tokens and per-action time, reproduced across two consecutive rounds), and update all docs.
